schedule.method: enumeration of 24 prioritized space-time A* planning orders (heuristic, no fixed priority)

multiway_cut.guarantee: Pinned witness paths are directed-connected and vertex/edge-swap collision-free on discrete grid; independent replan is checked but not automatically safe.

no_bays.proof: On a path graph with vertex and opposing-edge exclusion, left-to-right robot order is invariant. Opposite-end exchange is impossible without side branches.
